profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Backend Java Engineer working on the Domains International Platform Team.

Worked on a validation API, which was a RESTful asynchronous API built in Java,
that allowed us to validate customer information before they purchased a domain. 

Some of the technology used in this API included Java, Dropwizard, RabbitMQ, and Docker.

volunteerExperiences.description: Trained on marine science, public speaking, and customer service. Conversed with guests and shared knowledge of the animals and their exhibits.

projects.title: Parking Meter Web Application
projects.description:
Parking meter web application I built with three other team members. The purpose of our app was to find available and optimal parking meters within Vancouver, B.C. 

Technology used included Ruby, SQL, Heroku, HTML, JavaScript, Google Maps API

CPSC 310--Introduction to Software Engineering

projects.title: Restaurant Application
projects.description:
Implemented an Android application that used Yelp API and Google Directions API to collect restaurant data. The goal of the application is to guess the location of a restaurant with as few clicks as possible, within a limited amount of time. User selects a city within Canada and restaurant category.

CPSC 210--Software Construction
